purpose: Point-in-time daily AI-pool model-ready layer for a controls-only H21 baseline. The master contains active member trading-day rows; development labels are limited to training and validation and test targets are sealed.

membership.candidate_instruments_policy: If an external CSV is supplied by --candidate-list, read literal Instrument values from its Instrument column and retain the file hash. If omitted, derive the candidate universe from membership_status=member and membership_eligible=true. In either case, apply the latest known membership state as of each decision date and require the corrected member_from/member_to interval.
membership.as_of_policy: For each decision session, use the latest known membership record with formation_date <= decision session. Keep only membership_status=member and membership_eligible=true whose corrected member_from/member_to interval contains the decision session. Later ambiguous and unknown records are not carried forward as members.
membership.unknown_policy: Retain ambiguous and unknown source states in membership_snapshot_audit.csv with reason codes; do not include them in the active pool.
membership.identifier_policy: Use literal Instrument/RIC as security_id; no name-based mapping or issuer merge.

decision_and_label.feature_cutoff: All controls use the immediately preceding SPY session; no decision-day EOD feature is used.
decision_and_label.entry: Decision session close; target window starts on the next SPY session.
decision_and_label.target: y=1 when cumulative stock return minus cumulative SPY return over H21 is strictly positive; missing target is not set to zero.

splits.boundary_rule: Purge a whole earlier date sample when exit_session is on or after the next split start; only development labels before a split boundary are computed.
splits.non_overlap_rule: For each literal Instrument, retain at most one supervised anchor in each consecutive 21-SPY-session block; all daily master rows remain available with eligibility flags.

missing_policy.master_layer: Retain all active member trading-day rows and NA values; no zero fill, forward fill, backward fill, interpolation, winsorization, or physical row deletion.
missing_policy.model_layer: Median imputation with missing indicators for both models, fit on non-overlapping training rows only and applied unchanged to validation.

test_policy: Do not read, aggregate, score, rank, predict, or write any test-period future return. Test rows may retain daily schedule and eligibility metadata, but target values are absent and test_target_sealed is recorded.
